about: Safety and override policy for `sharukhan verify|run --package-lifecycle` (ADR-0008, FRD-002). Every entry carries the reason it exists. Criteria that can be derived from the guest (unit ordering, conflicts, the unit that owns the ssh listener, files under /boot) are derived in code; this file holds only what cannot be derived, and is embedded into the binary so a result names the exact policy that produced it (its sha256 is recorded with every run).
